name: eSIM Go
description: Browse and purchase eSIM Go bundles, provision eSIMs, retrieve installation details, inspect usage allowances, suspend service, and send SMS to supported eSIMs.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: eSIM Go API key from Account Settings > API Details. Configure provider IP allowlisting if enabled for the organisation.

tools.name: get_organisation
tools.description: Read the eSIM Go organisation and account balance.

tools.name: list_catalogue
tools.description: Browse available eSIM Go bundles with country, region, group, and pagination filters.

perPage.description: Number of Bundles to return per page

orderBy.description: Name of column to order by

group.description: Filter by Bundle Group (exact value) e.g. `Standard eSIM Bundles`

countries.description: Comma-separated list of country ISO codes to filter by. This will search for Bundles that include at least one of the countries as their base country. e.g. `GB, US`

region.description: This will return Bundles that have a base country in the specified region. e.g. `Europe`

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: Read an eSIM Go bundle from the catalogue.

name.description: (Required) Name of Bundle to get countries for. Bundle names are case sensitive.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List eSIM Go orders with optional ICCID details.

includeIccids.description: Set to true to include eSIM data (ICCID, Matching ID and SMDP Address) in the response, and an ICCIDs array.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

createdAt.description: Specifies the date range for filtering orders. This parameter has a 'lte:' prefix to specify the end date. For example, to query orders from March 1, 2024, to March 31, 2024, use the following format: `createdAt=gte:2024-03-01T00:00:00.000Z&createdAt=lte:2024-03-31T23:59:59.999Z`.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Validate or purchase bundles. Use type=validate to check the order, or type=transaction to place a billed order. Set assign to attach purchased bundles to eSIMs.

assign.description: To specify if bundle(s) to be assigned to eSIM(s)

quantity.description: Quantity of the bundles to purchase. If you purchase several different bundles, specify the quantity of each item separately.

iccids.description: ICCID of the eSIM to assign bundle to (quantity of items and number of ICCIDs should match)

allowReassign.description: Allow a new eSIM to be provided if the bundle is not compatible with the eSIM profile

profileID.description: Optional identifier for selecting a specific eSIM branding profile when multiple profiles exist.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read details of an eSIM Go order.

tools.name: list_esims
tools.description: List eSIMs assigned to the organisation.

perPage.description: Number of ESIMs to return per page

orderBy.description: Name of column to order by

filterBy.description: Name of column to filter by. eSIMs can be filtered by ICCID, Customer Reference, Last Action (Bundle Refund, Bundle Applied, Bundle Revoked, eSIM Updated, eSIM Refreshed, eSIM Utilisation Alert), Last Action Date and SIM Assignment Date.

tools.name: get_esim
tools.description: Read an eSIM and its status by ICCID.

tools.name: get_install_details
tools.description: Read eSIM installation details for an order or bundle assignment reference.

tools.name: list_esim_bundles
tools.description: List bundles assigned to an eSIM.

includeUsed.description:
Include used & expired Bundles
Backward compatibility for v2.1

limit.description: Number of assignments to return. Must be between 1 and 200. Default is 15

tools.name: get_esim_bundle
tools.description: Read remaining allowance and status for an assigned bundle.

name.description: (Required) Name of Bundle Format as defined in [List Catalogue](/api/#get-/catalogue) API call. Example: `esim_1GB_7D_REUP_V2`

tools.name: get_esim_location
tools.description: Read the last known operator and location of an eSIM.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send a UTF-8 SMS to an eSIM Go SIM identified by ICCID. The default sender is eSIM. Custom sender names require provider approval.

from.description:
Name of sender that will show in SMS.

This defaults to `eSIM` and is the only supported value by default. Unique identifiers can be assigned to your Organisation on request.

tools.name: set_esim_suspension
tools.description: Set suspend=true to stop service or suspend=false to restore it.

tools.name: apply_bundle
tools.description: Apply an inventory bundle to an eSIM. Omit iccid to allocate a new eSIM. Use get_install_details with the returned assignment reference.

iccid.description: ICCID of target eSIM to apply Bundle to. If not provided, a new eSIM will be assigned to you.

repeat.description: How many eSIMs will be assigned with this bundle applied (if left empty Bundle will assign to one eSIM)

allowReassign.description: Allow a new eSIM to be provided if the bundle is not compatible with the eSIM profile
